Interface TaskService

public interface TaskService
Service contract for academic task management, lifecycle transitions, and study plan operations.

    • listTasks

      List<TaskResponse> listTasks(Long courseId, TaskStatus status, Boolean scheduled)
      Retrieves all tasks matching optional course, status, and scheduling filter criteria.
      Parameters:
      courseId - optional course ID filter; null to match all courses
      status - optional task status filter; null to match all statuses
      scheduled - optional scheduling filter: true for scheduled tasks, false for unscheduled/later tasks, or null for all tasks
      Returns:
      list of matching task responses, ordered by creation date descending
